summary: Tipperary-born daughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney who married Edmund Grimes; John's 1st cousin 5 times removed.
bio: Catherine Heffernan was born in County Tipperary, Ireland, in 1833, or by one account 1836, the daughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney; her birthplace was an early clue to the family's Tipperary origins. She married Edmund Grimes and died in 1908. Two of her sons died in mining accidents: Richard E. Grimes (about 1858–1909) was killed at the Boston D&H colliery, and Edmund D. Grimes died in a California mine accident in 1927. She is John's 1st cousin 5 times removed.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
